senses.zh_definition: 可能对应日本专名 Mishima（三岛）；一个已核实的指称是日本静冈县三岛市，但输入不足以确定此处所指。
senses.en_definition: A possible Japanese proper name, including the city of Mishima in Shizuoka Prefecture; the intended referent is unresolved.
senses.ms_definition: Kemungkinan nama khas Jepun, termasuk nama bandar Mishima di wilayah Shizuoka; rujukan sebenar dalam input belum dapat dipastikan. Huraian ini bukan definisi rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 这是候选指称，不能据此认定原始词频记录指向三岛市。专名在正文中应写作 Mishima。城市身份可参见[三岛市官方旅游指南](https://mishima-tourism.jp/)。

collocations.zh: 前往三岛的访问或游览

senses.zh_definition: 陶艺中的候选义：以对比色泥料填嵌刻纹或印纹的装饰技法，亦用于相关陶器风格的名称。
senses.en_definition: In ceramics, an inlay technique using contrasting clay or slip, also associated with a pottery style.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam seni seramik, teknik hiasan dengan mengisi corak turisan atau teraan menggunakan tanah liat atau slip yang berlainan warna; juga berkaitan dengan nama gaya tembikar. Huraian ini bukan definisi rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 陶艺义有博物馆术语依据，但未确认本输入采用此义，也未确认其作为马来语正式词条的地位。下列搭配是解释性专业短语，未声称具有高频统计依据。参见[Fitzwilliam Museum](https://data.fitzmuseum.cam.ac.uk/id/terminology/term-27673)。

etymology.historical_story: In ceramic terminology, Mishima connects Korean pottery with Japanese naming practices. Contrasting clay inlays decorate the surface, and Japanese collectors applied the name to Korean wares. This documented artistic history explains one possible meaning of the string, but it does not establish which meaning occurs in the supplied Malay vocabulary record. [Source: Getty AAT](https://www.getty.edu/vow/AATFullDisplay?find=paper+negative&logic=AND&note=&page=1&subjectid=300053917).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 若语境是陶艺，就把 mishima 联想为深色陶面里嵌入浅色细纹；若是地名，则记作 Mishima＝三岛。先看语境，再选含义。
